facts.text: Every student at Reed completes a year-long senior thesis research or creative project.

sources.title: Curious About Reed? - Admission & Aid
sources.quote: Every Student. Completes a senior thesis. An original year-long research or creative project.

facts.text: Reed does not distribute regular grade reports to students in order to foster studying for knowledge rather than grades.

sources.title: Glossary of helpful terms and links - Office of the Registrar
sources.quote: Students are not sent regular grade reports, because of the college's commitment to encouraging students to study for the knowledge to be gained, rather than for the grade earned.
